## Fill-Realism Correction

**Problem identified:** Original sim filled at `sig.entry_price +/- 0.25 friction`.
Live `entry_manager` places MARKET orders; by 1m bar close the price has already
moved through the breakout level.  Worst case: 2026-07-01T14:00 SESSION_BREAKOUT
BUY booked +$102.34 — the detection bar closed ABOVE the TP, meaning live never
opens the position.

**Correction method:**

    detection bar  = 1m bar whose open time == entry_time in the CSV
    new_entry_px   = bar_close + 0.25  (BUY)
                   = bar_close - 0.25  (SELL)
    friction       = 0.25 (spread/2 = 0.15 + slippage = 0.10)

    Phantom guard:
      BUY:  new_entry_px >= tp  -> drop trade (live never opens it)
      SELL: new_entry_px <= tp  -> drop trade

Exit prices are unchanged for all outcome types (TP, SL, TIME, TRAIL).
For TRAIL exits this is exact -- trail_dist = abs(sig.entry_price - sig.stop_loss)
is anchored to signal parameters, not the fill, so exit_px is independent of fill.

| Corrected pnl_usd | DROPPED |

**S96 ungated fill anomaly (important caveat):** The corrected ungated S96 swings
from -$4,946 (raw) to +$4,212 (corrected) -- a +$9,158 reversal on 144 trades
(avg +$63.60/trade correction).  This occurs because S96's sig.entry_price is a
computed momentum level (H4/H1 EMA) that sits systematically away from the
detection-bar close.  For SELL signals, a higher bar_close improves the corrected
fill; in ranging conditions, price frequently spikes above the SELL signal level
within the detection bar, yielding a more favourable corrected entry.  This is a
real finding about S96's signal structure, not a correction error.  However,
since the corrected ungated combined (+$4,122) is dominated by this fill-basis
offset rather than genuine directional edge, it SHOULD NOT be compared directly
to the corrected gated (+$133) for the rubric test.  Use the ex-S96 view below
for a reliable gating-edge signal.

## Ex-S96 View

S96 (KRONOS_S96_H1_MOMENTUM) supplied +$212.87 gated / -$4,946 ungated in the
raw sim and dominates the apparent gating edge.  TRENDING regime was only 5.7%
of the 3-month window, giving 10 gated and 144 ungated S96 trades -- far too few
for statistical confidence.  The ex-S96 view isolates the residual edge from the
three other strategies (S95, S97, SESSION_BREAKOUT).

| Mode | Raw Net $ (0.02L) | Phantoms | Corrected Net $ (0.02L) | Corrected Net $ (0.01L) |
|------|------------------:|---------:|------------------------:|------------------------:|
| Gated ex-S96 | +364.49 | 3 | +44.07 | +22.04 |
| Ungated ex-S96 | -148.78 | 7 | -89.11 | -44.56 |
| **Delta ex-S96 (G-U)** | **+513.27** | -- | **+133.18** | -- |

The gating edge is preserved in the ex-S96 view: corrected gated +$44 vs
corrected ungated -$89, confirming the regime gate adds value for
SESSION_BREAKOUT even after removing S96's fill-anomaly effect.

Raw combined delta (G-U) = +5,671.80; ex-S96 raw delta = +513.27;
corrected ex-S96 delta = +133.18 (25.7% of raw ex-S96 delta survives correction).
The large compression reflects SESSION_BREAKOUT's sensitivity to late fills.

deploy_manager.py sets MANAGER_CHILD_LOT=0.01 (half the sim's 0.02 lots).
All live P&L figures are exactly half the 0.02L sim figures.

| Scenario | Net 3 months (0.02L sim) | Net 3 months (0.01L live) |

| Corrected gated combined | +133.36 | +66.68 |
| Corrected ex-S96 gated | +44.07 | +22.04 |
| Corrected gated S96 only | +89.29 | +44.64 |
| Corrected gated SESSION_BREAKOUT | +84.69 | +42.35 |

Kill-switch: $150 floor is calibrated to 0.02L sim behaviour.  At 0.01L live,
a $150 intraday loss equals a ~3-sigma adverse run -- effectively 2x tighter
than the sim's equivalent risk budget.  Consider raising the kill-switch to $200
or lowering individual child lots once paper mode confirms fill quality.

Corrected gated combined net = **+$133.36 at 0.02L (+$66.68 at 0.01L)** over
3 months (raw was +$577.36).  PF estimated ~1.1, concentrated in
SESSION_BREAKOUT (+$84.69 corrected, 53 trades) and a 10-trade S96 sample
(+$89.29 corrected).  S95 is near breakeven; S97 is negative both modes.

Live promotion is contingent on all of the following:

1. **Sensitivity grid** -- re-run with --sensitivity flag to confirm the gating
   edge is not parameter-sensitive.  A parameter-sensitive delta sign-flip would
   downgrade to DO NOT RECOMMEND.

2. **S96 live-eligibility reconciliation** -- TRENDING was only 5.7% of this
   window, producing 10 gated S96 trades.  The S96 fill anomaly (sig.entry_price
   systematically offset from bar_close) must be understood before S96 goes live.
   Confirm the TRENDING gate is airtight.  Do not scale S96 until a minimum
   30-trade live sample is available.

3. **Paper fills confirming corrected expectancy** -- paper target is
   ~+$133 at 0.02L / ~+$67 at 0.01L over 3 months.  If paper shows
   consistent underperformance, investigate SESSION_BREAKOUT entry timing further.

4. **S97 review (consider NOT arming)** -- KRONOS_S97_SNAP_SCALPER is negative
   in both raw (-$62.82) and corrected (-$41.38) gated modes.  Current
   recommendation is PAPER only; exclude S97 from any live arming until it shows
   positive corrected expectancy on a fresh window.

5. **S95 status** -- KRONOS_S95_SESSION_BREAKOUT is near breakeven (+$0.76 raw,
   +$0.76 corrected gated).  Acceptable as a regime-filtered scalper at small
   size; does not drive expectancy.
